name: Pac-Man 99: Deluxe Pack
summary:
Mode Unlock

The Mode Unlock DLC added the following offline game modes to Pac-Man 99:
CPU Battle allows the player to play the regular PAC-MAN 99 mode against computer-controlled players. The computer player difficulty, starting speed and badges can be configured before playing.
Score Attack tasks the player to achieve a total of 3,333,360 points with three extra lives supplied during play.
Blind Time Attack gives the player a starting time limit of 1 minute and 30 seconds to eat twelve fruits. Time can be extended by scoring enough points before eating the bonus fruit, however extra time will decrease if Pac-Man is caught.
The ability to create private matches for the regular Pac-Man 99 mode was also added, though this feature was disabled following the shutdown of the game’s servers on October 8, 2023.
